  • Method Details

    • anchor

      public MKHudNotification.Builder anchor(MKHudAnchor anchor, int offsetX, int offsetY)
      Sets the screen-edge anchor and offset (default: TOP_CENTER, 0, 10).

      Legacy positioning path. HudRegion (via region(HudRegion)) is the intended primary system, matching MKHudPanel; it routes through the same RegionMath.resolveHud(HudRegion, int, int, int, int, int) math panels use. anchor(...) remains for back-compat and for the MKHudAnchor.CENTER_LEFT/ MKHudAnchor.CENTER_RIGHT vertical-center positions that HudRegion spells differently. Setting both is allowed; region wins when present.

    • region

      public MKHudNotification.Builder region(HudRegion region)
      Positions this notification via a named HudRegion — the parity path with MKHudPanel.builder(String)'s .region(...). Position resolves through RegionMath.resolveHud(HudRegion, int, int, int, int, int) (the same math HUD panels use) with a zero stacking prefix, since a notification is a singular popup rather than a registry-stacked panel. The builder's offset (default 0, 10) nudges the resolved origin — call anchor(MKHudAnchor, int, int)'s offset args are reused, or set a custom offset by also calling anchor(...) for the offset only (region still wins for placement).
      Parameters:
      region - the HUD region anchor
      Returns:
      this builder, for chaining

    • region

      public MKHudNotification.Builder region(RegionAnchor<HudRegion> anchor)
      Region overload accepting a RegionAnchor — region paired with a priority. Notifications don't stack in a region registry, so the priority is accepted for signature parity with MKHudPanel but is not consulted (a notification resolves at the region's anchor with a zero prefix). Equivalent to .region(anchor.region()).
